methodology.entry: next available M1 bar open after signal timestamp
methodology.direction: signal direction from event ID / explicit direction field
methodology.costs: observed entry/exit spread plus deterministic slippage stress and separate generic round-trip commission-bps assumptions
methodology.commission_assumption: basis points of notional deducted once per completed trade; sensitivity analysis only, not a broker-specific commission schedule
methodology.overlapping_event_compounding: not computed because overlapping event returns are not a portfolio equity curve
limitations: event-level results are not a broker-executable portfolio backtest
non-overlapping diagnostic is an idealized fixed-horizon event study
slippage values are stress assumptions, not measured historical fills
commission bps are generic assumptions, not broker-specific per-lot costs
always-long/short baselines use the same event timestamps, holding windows, and cost assumptions

scenarios.spread_source: observed MT5 bar spread at entry/exit; points × 0.01 USD
scenarios.commission_model: generic round-trip notional-bps stress; not broker-specific
